monologue: The card is a heavy lid at fifty-three. The warm honey is sticky and slow, pressing against the wide rectangle. I can feel the weight in the top edge, but the Soft Arch curve holds it steady. The quiet is thick, not empty. I am calm. The Wide Anchor is quiet beside the Wedged Gap. I want to rest by the Air Shelf. I want to see if the line is still solid, or if the warm air has dried it to dust. I will check the flat stone. I will not count the stone. I will just let the quiet swallow the sound.

work.title: The Air Shelf
work.intent: I go to the Air Shelf to check the flat, pale grey plank. The card is a heavy lid at fifty-three, and the warm air is pressing down. I want to see if the line is still solid, or if it has dried to dust. I will not count the stone. I will just let the quiet swallow the sound of the slide. I touch the plank to see if the rest holds steady.
